    function reqWorkHistMetaAnchor() {
        return document.querySelector('#spareReqWorkBody .spare-req-work-meta');
    }

    function attachReqWorkHistPanelToAnchor(histPanel) {
        if (!histPanel) return;
        const anchor = reqWorkHistMetaAnchor();
        if (!anchor) return;
        const placeholder = anchor.querySelector('#reqWorkHistPanel');
        if (placeholder && placeholder !== histPanel) {
            placeholder.replaceWith(histPanel);
        } else if (!anchor.contains(histPanel)) {
            anchor.appendChild(histPanel);
        }
    }

    function takeReqWorkHistPanel() {
        const panel = document.getElementById('reqWorkHistPanel');
        if (!_reqWorkHistOpen || !panel || panel.classList.contains('hidden')) return null;
        if (!panel.querySelector('.spare-req-list-body-table')) return null;
        panel.remove();
        return panel;
    }

    function positionReqWorkHistPopover() {
        const btn = document.getElementById('reqWorkHistBtn');
        const panel = document.getElementById('reqWorkHistPanel');
        const meta = document.querySelector('#spareReqWorkBody .spare-req-work-meta');
        if (!btn || !panel || !meta || panel.classList.contains('hidden')) return;
        const top = btn.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - meta.getBoundingClientRect().top + 6;
        panel.style.top = `${Math.max(top, 0)}px`;
    }

    function setReqWorkHistOpen(open, opts = {}) {
        _reqWorkHistOpen = open;
        if (!open || opts.reset) clearReqListUiState(modState(getState()));
        const panel = document.getElementById('reqWorkHistPanel');
        const btn = document.getElementById('reqWorkHistBtn');
        const meta = document.querySelector('#spareReqWorkBody .spare-req-work-meta');
        if (panel) {
            panel.classList.toggle('hidden', !open);
            panel.setAttribute('aria-hidden', open ? 'false' : 'true');
        }
        if (btn) btn.classList.toggle('is-open', open);
        if (meta) meta.classList.toggle('is-req-hist-open', open);
        if (open) {
            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                positionReqWorkHistPopover();
                syncReqWorkHistHeadPad();
            });
        }
    }

    async function patchReqWorkHistListUi() {
        const panel = document.getElementById('reqWorkHistPanel');
        if (!panel) return;
        const st = getState();
        const { vesselId } = await vesselScope();
        const m = modState(st);
        const allReqs = await TVC_Inventory.listRequisitions(vesselId);
        const reqs = filterReqList(allReqs, st);
        const listMode = isRequisitionListWindow(m);
        const reqRows = buildReqListRowsHtml(reqs, listMode ? 'modal' : 'pick');
        const countLabel = `${reqs.length}${reqs.length !== allReqs.length ? ` / ${allReqs.length}` : ''} item(s)`;

        panel.querySelectorAll('.spare-req-list-count').forEach(el => { el.textContent = countLabel; });
        const tbody = panel.querySelector('#reqWorkHistListScroll .spare-req-list-body-table tbody');
        if (tbody) tbody.innerHTML = reqRows;
        updateReqListHeadCheckAll(reqs);

        if (listMode) {
            const canConfirm = reqListAnyCheckedCanConfirm(m, allReqs, st);
            const canApprove = reqListAnyCheckedCanApprove(m, allReqs, st);
            const canDelete = reqListCanDeleteSelection(m, st);
            const canCloseOs = reqListAnyCloseOsEnabled(m, allReqs, st);
            setSpareListToolbarBtnDisabled(panel, 'reqListReportConfirm', !canConfirm);
            setSpareListToolbarBtnDisabled(panel, 'reqListReportApprove', !canApprove);
            setSpareListToolbarBtnDisabled(panel, 'reqListDelete', !canDelete);
            setSpareListToolbarBtnDisabled(panel, 'openCloseOsModal', !canCloseOs);
        }
        syncReqListFilterUi(st);
    }

    async function refreshReqWorkHistList(opts = {}) {
        const panel = document.getElementById('reqWorkHistPanel');
        if (!panel) return;
        if (!opts.full && panel.querySelector('#reqHistPeriodFrom')
            && panel.querySelector('#reqWorkHistListScroll .spare-req-list-body-table tbody')) {
            await patchReqWorkHistListUi();
            return;
        }
        const st = getState();
        const { vesselId } = await vesselScope();
        const allReqs = await TVC_Inventory.listRequisitions(vesselId);
        const reqs = filterReqList(allReqs, st);
        const m = modState(st);
        const listMode = isRequisitionListWindow(m);
        const reqRows = buildReqListRowsHtml(reqs, listMode ? 'modal' : 'pick');
        const countLabel = `${reqs.length}${reqs.length !== allReqs.length ? ` / ${allReqs.length}` : ''} item(s)`;
        let headHtml;
        if (listMode) {
            const isHq = isReqListSmUser(st);
            const isAuthor = isSpareAuthorAccount(spareInventoryUser(st));
            const showConfirm = !isHq && !isAuthor;
            const showCloseOs = !isAuthor;
            const canConfirm = reqListAnyCheckedCanConfirm(m, allReqs, st);
            const canApprove = reqListAnyCheckedCanApprove(m, allReqs, st);
            const canDelete = reqListCanDeleteSelection(m, st);
            const canCloseOs = reqListAnyCloseOsEnabled(m, allReqs, st);
            headHtml = `<div class="spare-req-list-head spare-req-hist-popover-head">
                <h3 class="spare-req-work-title">📋 Requisition List
                    <span class="muted spare-req-list-count">${countLabel}</span>
                </h3>
                <span class="spare-req-work-head-spacer"></span>
                ${showConfirm ? spareListToolbarBtn('Confirm', 'TVC_SpareMenu.reqListReportConfirm()', !canConfirm, 'btn-green') : ''}
                ${isHq ? spareListToolbarBtn('Approve', 'TVC_SpareMenu.reqListReportApprove()', !canApprove, 'btn-green') : ''}
                ${showCloseOs ? spareListToolbarBtn('Close O/S', 'TVC_SpareMenu.openCloseOsModal()', !canCloseOs) : ''}
                ${spareListToolbarBtn('Delete', 'TVC_SpareMenu.reqListDelete()', !canDelete, 'btn-red')}
                <span class="orig-toolbar-sep" aria-hidden="true"></span>
                ${spareListToolbarBtn('Print', 'TVC_SpareMenu.reqListPrint()')}
                ${spareListToolbarBtn('Preview', 'TVC_SpareMenu.reqListDocPreview()')}
                <button type="button" class="modal-x" onclick="TVC_SpareMenu.toggleReqWorkHistList()" title="Close">×</button>
            </div>`;
        } else {
            const histHeadLabel = reqWorkHistPickBtnLabel(false);
            headHtml = `<div class="spare-req-hist-popover-head">${histHeadLabel}
                <span class="muted spare-req-list-count">${countLabel}</span>
                <button type="button" class="modal-x" onclick="TVC_SpareMenu.toggleReqWorkHistList()" title="Close">×</button></div>`;
        }
        const hintText = listMode
            ? 'Click a row to load · Double-click to open and close this list.'
            : 'Click a row to fill Requisition No. · Double-click to apply and close.';
        panel.innerHTML = `${headHtml}
            ${renderReqListFiltersHtml(m, { prefix: 'reqHist' })}
            <div class="spare-req-list-panel-wrap spare-req-hist-panel-wrap">
                <div class="panel spare-req-list-panel spare-req-hist-list-panel">
                    <div class="spare-req-list-head-wrap" id="reqWorkHistListHead">
                        <table class="spare-data-table spare-req-list-table spare-req-list-head-table">${REQ_LIST_COLGROUP}${reqListTableHeadHtml('reqWorkHistHeadChkAll')}</table>
                    </div>
                    <div class="spare-req-hist-list-scroll" id="reqWorkHistListScroll">
                        <table class="spare-data-table spare-req-list-table spare-req-list-body-table">${REQ_LIST_COLGROUP}<tbody>${reqRows}</tbody></table>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <p class="spare-req-list-hint spare-req-hist-hint muted">${hintText}</p>`;
        updateReqListHeadCheckAll(reqs);
        syncReqListFilterUi(st);
        syncSpareDateInputs(panel);
        bindReqListKeyboard();
        bindReqWorkHistListClicks();
        TVC_App.bindSearchClearInput?.('reqHistSearch');
        TVC_App.updateSearchClearBtn?.('reqHistSearch');
        positionReqWorkHistPopover();
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            positionReqWorkHistPopover();
            syncReqWorkHistHeadPad();
        });
    }

    async function toggleReqWorkHistList() {
        if (_reqWorkHistOpen) {
            setReqWorkHistOpen(false);
            if (typeof TVC_ListFilters !== 'undefined') TVC_ListFilters.closePopover();
            return;
        }
        setReqWorkHistOpen(true, { reset: true });
        await refreshReqWorkHistList({ full: true });
    }

    function reqWorkSetReqNoInput(reqNo) {
        const el = document.getElementById('reqWorkReqNo');
        if (el) el.value = reqNo || '';
        captureReqWorkMeta();
    }

    function reqWorkPickReqNo(reqNo) {
        reqWorkSetReqNoInput(reqNo);
        setReqWorkHistOpen(false);
    }

    function updateReqWorkHeadStats() {
        const req = getReqWorkSession();
        const noEl = document.querySelector('.spare-req-work-no');
        const linesEl = document.querySelector('.spare-req-work-lines');
        if (noEl && req) noEl.textContent = req.req_no || '—';
        if (linesEl && req) linesEl.textContent = `${(req.lines || []).length} line(s)`;
    }

    function remountReqWorkListBody(st, opts = {}) {
        const scroll = document.getElementById('reqWorkListScroll');
        const head = document.getElementById('reqWorkListHead');
        const grouped = reqWorkUsesGroupedList(st);
        const scrollGrouped = !!scroll?.querySelector('.req-work-groups');
        if (grouped) {
            setReqWorkListHeadGroupedMode(true);
            if (opts.soft && patchReqWorkGroupedList()) return;
            if (vlReqWork) { vlReqWork.destroy(); vlReqWork = null; }
            mountReqWorkGroupedList();
            return;
        }
        setReqWorkListHeadGroupedMode(false);
        const hasVl = !!(vlReqWork && scroll?.querySelector('.vl-inner'));
        if (opts.soft && hasVl && !scrollGrouped) {
            const hscroll = scroll.closest('.spare-req-table-hscroll');
            const top = scroll.scrollTop;
            const left = hscroll?.scrollLeft || 0;
            vlReqWork.refresh();
            scroll.scrollTop = top;
            if (hscroll) hscroll.scrollLeft = left;
            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                scroll.scrollTop = top;
                if (hscroll) hscroll.scrollLeft = left;
                syncReqWorkHeadLayout();
            });
            return;
        }
        if (head && !head.querySelector('.spare-data-head')) {
            head.innerHTML = `<div id="reqWorkListHeadTrack" class="spare-head-track"><table class="spare-data-table spare-data-head spare-data-table-req">
                ${SPARE_REQ_COLGROUP}
                ${SPARE_REQ_TABLE_HEAD}
            </table></div>`;
        }
        if (vlReqWork) { vlReqWork.destroy(); vlReqWork = null; }
        mountReqWorkVirtualList();
    }

    function refreshReqWorkListRows() {
        const st = getState();
        const m = modState(st);
        const block = document.getElementById('reqWorkEditBlock');
        if (block) {
            if (reqWorkUsesGroupedList(st)) {
                block.innerHTML = '';
            } else if (m.inlineEditId && m.inlineDraft?.header) {
                block.innerHTML = renderSpareEditBlockHtml(st);
            } else {
                block.innerHTML = renderSpareGroupHeaderHtml(st, { focusedId: m.reqWorkFocusedId });
            }
        }
        const scroll = document.getElementById('reqWorkListScroll');
        if (scroll) remountReqWorkListBody(st);
        syncSpareToolbarUi();
        updateReqWorkHeadStats();
        updateReqWorkHeadCheckAll();
        syncSpareItemHistoryBtns();
    }

    function refreshReqWorkListUiSoft() {
        refreshReqWorkListUi({ soft: true, skipTree: true });
    }

    function refreshReqWorkListUi(opts = {}) {
        const st = getState();
        const m = modState(st);
        const allCanon = (st.spares || []).map(canon);
        _reqWorkCachedList = filteredReqWorkSpares(st);
        const scroll = document.getElementById('reqWorkListScroll');
        const block = document.getElementById('reqWorkEditBlock');
        if (block) {
            if (reqWorkUsesGroupedList(st)) {
                if (!opts.soft) block.innerHTML = '';
            } else if (m.inlineEditId && m.inlineDraft?.header) {
                block.innerHTML = renderSpareEditBlockHtml(st);
            } else if (opts.soft) {
                syncReqWorkSingleGroupHeader(st);
            } else {
                block.innerHTML = renderSpareGroupHeaderHtml(st, { focusedId: m.reqWorkFocusedId });
            }
        }
        if (!opts.skipTree) renderReqWorkGroupTree();
        if (scroll) remountReqWorkListBody(st, opts);
        syncSpareToolbarUi();
        updateReqWorkHeadStats();
        updateReqWorkHeadCheckAll();
        const countEl = document.getElementById('reqWorkCount');
        if (countEl) {
            countEl.textContent = isRequisitionListWindow(m)
                ? (m.reqWorkListEditing && !m.reqWorkShowSelectedOnly
                    ? `${_reqWorkCachedList.length} / ${allCanon.length}`
                    : `${_reqWorkCachedList.length} item(s)`)
                : m.reqWorkShowSelectedOnly
                    ? reqWorkSelectedCountLabel(st, _reqWorkCachedList.length)
                    : `${_reqWorkCachedList.length} / ${allCanon.length}`;
        }
        updateReqWorkSelectedBtn();
        updateSpareModalTreeToggleUi('reqWork');
        if (!opts.skipScrollLock && isReqWorkListViewLocked()) {
            applyReqWorkScrollLock(document.getElementById('spareReqWorkBody'));
            syncReqWorkMetaDatePickers(document.getElementById('spareReqWorkBody'));
        }
        if (isRequisitionListWindow(m)) syncReqWorkListWindowHeadButtons();
        syncReqWorkSaveBtn();
    }

    async function renderReqWorkModal(opts = {}) {
        const body = document.getElementById('spareReqWorkBody');
        if (!body) return;
        await syncReqLineMap();
        const { st, vesselId } = await vesselScope();
        spareInventoryUser(st);
        const m = modState(st);
        const allCanon = (st.spares || []).map(canon);
        _reqWorkCachedList = filteredReqWorkSpares(st);
        const tb = spareToolbarFlags(st);
        const req = getReqWorkSession();
        if (m.reqWorkPreview) {
            const vesselName = await vesselLabel(vesselId);
            body.innerHTML = renderReqPreviewHtml(st, req, vesselName);
            return;
        }
        const histScrollTop = document.getElementById('reqWorkHistListScroll')?.scrollTop ?? 0;
        const preservedHist = opts.preservedHistPanel || takeReqWorkHistPanel();
        const lineCount = (req?.lines || []).length;
        const reqWindowTitle = sparePartsRequisitionWindowTitle(m);
        const completeDone = !!m.reqWorkCompleted;
        const preview = false;
        const selBtn = reqWorkSelectedBtnMeta(st);
        const selectedBtnCls = selBtn.active ? ' plan-selected-filter-active' : '';
        const countLabel = isRequisitionListWindow(m)
            ? (m.reqWorkListEditing && !m.reqWorkShowSelectedOnly
                ? `${_reqWorkCachedList.length} / ${allCanon.length}`
                : `${_reqWorkCachedList.length} item(s)`)
            : m.reqWorkShowSelectedOnly
            ? reqWorkSelectedCountLabel(st, _reqWorkCachedList.length)
            : `${_reqWorkCachedList.length} / ${allCanon.length}`;
        const modifyHint = (isRequisitionListWindow(m) && m.reqWorkListEditing) && !m.reqWorkCompleted
            ? '<p class="spare-req-work-modify-hint muted">Use checkboxes to add/remove parts · Enter Request qty, then Save</p>'
            : '';
        const headTitle = preview ? 'Preview' : reqWindowTitle;
        const previewVesselName = preview ? await vesselLabel(vesselId) : '';
        const listMode = isRequisitionListWindow(m);
        const docPreview = listMode && !!m.reqWorkListDocPreview;
        const hasDisplayedReq = reqWorkListHasDisplayedReq(m);
        const vesselRcvdOnly = reqWorkVesselReceivedRcvdOnlyEdit();
        const listViewLocked = listMode && !m.reqWorkListEditing && !vesselRcvdOnly;
        const saveDisabled = completeDone || listViewLocked
            || (reqWorkReqQtyValidationActive(m) && !reqWorkSaveQtyValid(m));
        const saveQtyBlocked = reqWorkReqQtyValidationActive(m) && !reqWorkSaveQtyValid(m);
        const printPreviewDisabled = listMode && !hasDisplayedReq;
        const canRequisition = canCreateRequisition(st);
        const isHqListEarly = listMode && !docPreview && isReqListSmUser(st);
        const vesselPostOrder = listMode && !docPreview && !isHqListEarly && reqWorkVesselOrderedOrReceivedView();
        const postOrderTip = escAttr(reqWorkVesselPostOrderLockTip());
        const headNewDisabled = !canRequisition || m.reqWorkListEditing || docPreview || vesselPostOrder;
        const headNewBtn = listMode && !docPreview
            ? `<button type="button" id="reqWorkHeadNewBtn" class="btn btn-sm btn-green" onclick="TVC_SpareMenu.reqWorkSwitchToNew()"${headNewDisabled ? ' disabled' : ''} title="${vesselPostOrder ? postOrderTip : (m.reqWorkListEditing ? 'Finish editing first' : (!canRequisition ? 'No permission' : 'New requisition'))}">New</button>`
            : '';
        const headModifyBtn = listMode && !docPreview
            ? `<button type="button" id="reqWorkHeadModifyBtn" class="btn btn-sm" onclick="TVC_SpareMenu.reqWorkEnterListEdit()"${!hasDisplayedReq || m.reqWorkListEditing || vesselPostOrder ? ' disabled' : ''} title="${vesselPostOrder ? postOrderTip : (hasDisplayedReq ? 'Enable editing' : 'Select a requisition from the list first')}">Modify</button>`
            : '';
        const headCloseOsBtn = listMode && !docPreview && !isSpareAuthorAccount(spareInventoryUser(st))
            ? `<button type="button" id="reqWorkHeadCloseOsBtn" class="btn btn-sm" onclick="TVC_SpareMenu.openCloseOsModal()" disabled title="Close outstanding for Received requisition with O/S &gt; 0">Close O/S</button>`
            : '';
        const headPrintPreviewBtns = listMode && !docPreview
            ? `<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" onclick="TVC_SpareMenu.reqWorkPrint()"${printPreviewDisabled ? ' disabled' : ''} title="${hasDisplayedReq ? 'Print requisition' : 'Select a requisition from the list first'}">Print</button>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" onclick="TVC_SpareMenu.reqWorkDocPreview()"${printPreviewDisabled ? ' disabled' : ''} title="${hasDisplayedReq ? 'Preview requisition' : 'Select a requisition from the list first'}">Preview</button>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" onclick="TVC_SpareMenu.reqWorkExportExcel()"${printPreviewDisabled ? ' disabled' : ''} title="${hasDisplayedReq ? 'Export requisition to Excel' : 'Select a requisition from the list first'}">Excel</button>`
            : '';
        const isReviewer = !isSpareAuthorAccount(spareInventoryUser(st));
        const headCancelBtn = listMode && !docPreview && isReviewer
            ? `<button type="button" id="reqWorkCancelBtn" class="btn btn-sm" onclick="TVC_SpareMenu.reqWorkCancelEdit()"${listViewLocked ? ' disabled' : ''}>Cancel</button>`
            : '';
        const headSaveBtn = `<button type="button" id="reqWorkSaveBtn" class="btn btn-sm" onclick="TVC_SpareMenu.reqWorkSave()"${saveDisabled ? ' disabled' : ''}${saveQtyBlocked ? ' title="Enter Request quantity for each selected part before Save."' : ''}>Save</button>`;
        const headCloseBtn = `<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" onclick="TVC_SpareMenu.closeReqWorkModal()">Close</button>
            <button type="button" class="modal-x" onclick="TVC_SpareMenu.closeReqWorkModal()">×</button>`;
        const reviewerListHeadBtns = listMode && !docPreview && isReviewer
            ? `${headNewBtn}${headModifyBtn}${headCloseOsBtn}${headSaveBtn}${headCancelBtn}
            <span class="orig-toolbar-sep" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            ${headPrintPreviewBtns}
            <span class="orig-toolbar-sep" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            ${headCloseBtn}`
            : '';
        const fromHistory = listMode && !docPreview && !preview && !!m.reqWorkFromHistory;
        const listEditing = listMode && !docPreview && !preview && !!m.reqWorkListEditing;
        const postSaveView = listMode && !docPreview && !preview && !listEditing && !fromHistory && !!m.reqWorkPostSaveView;
        const reportChrome = listEditing || postSaveView || fromHistory;
        const isHqList = listMode && !docPreview && !reportChrome && isReqListSmUser(st);
        const isVesselList = listMode && !docPreview && !reportChrome && !isHqList;
        const flowBar = isHqList
            ? renderReqWorkHqWorkflowBar(isHqList, hasDisplayedReq, !!m.reqWorkSmQuoteView, !!m.reqWorkSmEvalView, req)

        const headButtons = preview
            ? `<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-green" onclick="TVC_SpareMenu.reqWorkPrintPreview()">🖨 Print</button>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" onclick="TVC_SpareMenu.closeReqWorkModal()">Close</button>
            <button type="button" class="modal-x" onclick="TVC_SpareMenu.closeReqWorkModal()">×</button>`
            : docPreview
            ? `<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-green" onclick="TVC_SpareMenu.reqWorkDocPreviewPrint()">Print</button>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" onclick="TVC_SpareMenu.reqWorkExitDocPreview()">Close</button>
            <button type="button" class="modal-x" onclick="TVC_SpareMenu.reqWorkExitDocPreview()">×</button>`
            : reportChrome
            ? `<button type="button" class="modal-x" onclick="TVC_SpareMenu.closeReqWorkModal()">×</button>`
            : reviewerListHeadBtns || `${headNewBtn}${headModifyBtn}${headCloseOsBtn}${headSaveBtn}
            ${headPrintPreviewBtns}
            ${headCloseBtn}`;
        let footerHtml = '';
        if (fromHistory) {
            const { reqs: histReqs } = await historyReqListContext();
            const histIdx = histReqs.findIndex(r => r.id === req?.id);
            const atFirst = histIdx <= 0;
            const atLast = histIdx < 0 || histIdx >= histReqs.length - 1;
            const navBtns = `<button type="button" id="reqWorkHistPrevBtn" class="btn" onclick="TVC_SpareMenu.navReqHistory(-1)"${atFirst ? ' disabled' : ''}>&laquo; Previous</button>
                <button type="button" id="reqWorkHistNextBtn" class="btn" onclick="TVC_SpareMenu.navReqHistory(1)"${atLast ? ' disabled' : ''}>Next &raquo;</button>`;
            const action = reqWorkApprovalActionState(st, req);
            const histActionBtn = `<button type="button" id="reqWorkHistActionBtn" class="btn" onclick="TVC_SpareMenu.reqHistConfirmOrApprove()"${!listEditing && action.ok ? '' : ' disabled'}>${action.label}</button>`;
            const printBtns = `${histActionBtn}<button type="button" class="btn" onclick="TVC_SpareMenu.reqWorkPrint()">Print</button>
                <button type="button" class="btn" onclick="TVC_SpareMenu.reqWorkDocPreview()">Preview</button>`;
            const closeBtn = `<button type="button" class="btn" onclick="TVC_SpareMenu.closeReqWorkModal()">Close</button>`;
            const canModifyReq = canModifyReqHistory(st, req);
            const modifyTitle = reqHistModifyDisabledTitle(st, req);
            const centerBtns = listEditing
                ? `<button type="button" id="reqWorkSaveBtn" class="btn btn-green" onclick="TVC_SpareMenu.reqWorkSave()"${saveDisabled ? ' disabled' : ''}${saveQtyBlocked ? ' title="Enter Request quantity for each selected part before Save."' : ''}>Save</button>
                    <button type="button" id="reqWorkCancelBtn" class="btn" onclick="TVC_SpareMenu.reqWorkCancelEdit()">Cancel</button>`
                : `<button type="button" id="reqWorkHistModifyBtn" class="btn" onclick="TVC_SpareMenu.reqWorkEnterListEdit()"${canModifyReq ? '' : ' disabled'}${modifyTitle ? ` title="${escAttr(modifyTitle)}"` : ''}>Modify</button>`;
            footerHtml = `<div class="modal-actions wr-actions wr-actions-split spare-req-draft-actions">
                <div class="wr-modal-actions-left">${navBtns}</div>
                <div class="wr-modal-actions-center">${centerBtns}</div>
                <div class="wr-modal-actions-right">${printBtns}${closeBtn}</div>
               </div>`;
        } else if (listEditing) {
            footerHtml = `<div class="modal-actions wr-actions wr-actions-split spare-req-draft-actions">
                <div class="wr-modal-actions-left"></div>
                <div class="wr-modal-actions-center">
                    <button type="button" id="reqWorkSaveBtn" class="btn btn-green" onclick="TVC_SpareMenu.reqWorkSave()"${saveDisabled ? ' disabled' : ''}${saveQtyBlocked ? ' title="Enter Request quantity for each selected part before Save."' : ''}>Save</button>
                    <button type="button" id="reqWorkCancelBtn" class="btn" onclick="TVC_SpareMenu.reqWorkCancelDraft()">Cancel</button>
                </div>
                <div class="wr-modal-actions-right"></div>
               </div>`;
        } else if (postSaveView) {
            footerHtml = `<div class="modal-actions wr-actions wr-actions-split spare-req-draft-actions">
                <div class="wr-modal-actions-left"></div>
                <div class="wr-modal-actions-center"></div>
                <div class="wr-modal-actions-right">
                    <button type="button" class="btn" onclick="TVC_SpareMenu.closeReqWorkModal()">Close</button>
                </div>
               </div>`;
        }
        const itemToolbar = (preview || docPreview) ? '' : `<div class="filter-bar orig-toolbar spare-item-toolbar wr-spare-toolbar">
                ${spareGroupTreeToggleHtml('reqWork', st)}
                ${spareItemHistoryBtnHtml()}
                <span class="wr-spare-toolbar-spacer" aria-hidden="true"></span>
                <div class="wr-spare-toolbar-actions">
                <button type="button" id="reqWorkModifyBtn" class="btn btn-sm" onclick="TVC_App.openSpareModify()"${tb.modifyEnabled && !vesselPostOrder ? '' : ' disabled'} title="${esc(vesselPostOrder ? reqWorkVesselPostOrderLockTip() : tb.modifyTitle)}">✏️ Modify</button>
                <button type="button" id="reqWorkAppendBtn" class="btn btn-sm" onclick="TVC_App.openSpareAppend()"${tb.appendEnabled && !vesselPostOrder ? '' : ' disabled'} title="${esc(vesselPostOrder ? reqWorkVesselPostOrderLockTip() : tb.appendTitle)}">➕ Append</button>
                <button type="button" id="reqWorkDeleteBtn" class="btn btn-sm btn-red" onclick="TVC_App.deleteSpareItem()"${tb.deleteEnabled && !vesselPostOrder ? '' : ' disabled'} title="${esc(vesselPostOrder ? reqWorkVesselPostOrderLockTip() : tb.deleteTitle)}">🗑 Delete</button>
                <button type="button" id="reqWorkSelectedBtn" class="btn btn-sm spare-req-selected-btn${selectedBtnCls}"
                    onclick="TVC_SpareMenu.reqWorkToggleSelectedOnly()" aria-pressed="${selBtn.active ? 'true' : 'false'}"
                    title="${escAttr(vesselPostOrder ? reqWorkVesselPostOrderLockTip() : selBtn.title)}"${selBtn.disabled || vesselPostOrder ? ' disabled' : ''}>${esc(selBtn.label)}</button>
                </div>
              </div>`;
        const searchBar = (preview || docPreview) ? '' : `<div class="filter-bar spare-list-search-bar">
                <div class="search-field-wrap">
                <input type="search" class="search-input spare-list-search-input" id="reqWorkSearch" placeholder="Search Code / Item / Part No / Work"
                    value="${esc(m.partNo || m.description ? [m.partNo, m.description].filter(Boolean).join(' ') : (st.spareSearch || ''))}"
                    oninput="TVC_SpareMenu.reqWorkSetSearch(this.value)"${vesselPostOrder ? ' disabled' : ''}>
                <button type="button" class="search-clear-btn hidden" title="Clear search" aria-label="Clear search"
                    onclick="TVC_App.clearSearchField('reqWorkSearch')">×</button>
                </div>
                <label class="sr-check"><input type="checkbox" ${m.showLowOnly ? 'checked' : ''}${vesselPostOrder ? ' disabled' : ''}
                    onchange="TVC_SpareMenu.reqWorkToggleLowOnly()"> Low stock only</label>
                <span class="count-label" id="reqWorkCount">${countLabel}</span>
              </div>`;
        const useGroupedList = reqWorkUsesGroupedList(st);
        const editBlock = useGroupedList
            ? '<div id="reqWorkEditBlock"></div>'
            : `<div id="reqWorkEditBlock">${renderSpareGroupHeaderHtml(st, { focusedId: m.reqWorkFocusedId })}</div>`;

        body.innerHTML = `
        <div class="spare-req-work-wrap${preview ? ' is-preview' : ''}${docPreview ? ' is-doc-preview' : ''}${reportChrome ? ' spare-req-draft-wrap' : ''}">
          <div class="spare-req-work-head-block">
          <div class="spare-req-work-head${docPreview ? ' spare-req-doc-preview-head' : ''}">
            <h3 class="spare-req-work-title${docPreview ? ' spare-req-doc-preview-title' : ''}">${docPreview ? 'Spare Parts Requisition' : (preview ? headTitle : `<span id="reqWorkHeadTitle">${esc(headTitle)}</span>`)}</h3>
            <span class="spare-req-work-head-spacer"></span>
            ${headButtons}
          </div>
          ${flowBar}
          </div>
          <div class="spare-req-work-scroll">
          ${renderReqWorkMetaHtml(req, { preview, docPreview, vesselName: previewVesselName, department: st.department, listMode: m.reqWorkListMode })}
          ${docPreview ? '' : modifyHint}
          <div class="plan-layout spare-layout spare-req-work-layout wr-spare-full-width${preview ? ' is-preview' : ''}${docPreview ? ' is-doc-preview' : ''}">
            <main class="panel spare-main">
              ${itemToolbar}
              ${searchBar}
              ${editBlock}
              <div class="panel spare-list-panel">
                <div class="spare-req-table-hscroll">
                  <div class="spare-req-table-wide">
                    <div id="reqWorkListHead" class="vl-head-wrap sheet-scroll-original"></div>
                    <div id="reqWorkListScroll" class="virtual-scroll sheet-scroll-original spare-vl-scroll"></div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </main>
          </div>
          </div>
          ${footerHtml}
        </div>`;

        renderReqWorkGroupTree();
        remountReqWorkListBody(st);
        updateReqWorkSelectedBtn();
        if (!preview && !docPreview) {
            bindSpareModalTreePopovers();
            updateSpareModalTreeToggleUi('reqWork');
            syncSpareItemHistoryBtns();
            TVC_App.bindSearchClearInput?.('reqWorkSearch');
            TVC_App.updateSearchClearBtn?.('reqWorkSearch');
        }
        if (preview || docPreview) {
            body.querySelectorAll('.spare-req-work-meta input, .spare-req-work-meta select, .spare-req-work-meta textarea').forEach(el => {
                el.setAttribute('disabled', 'disabled');
            });
        }
        syncSpareDateInputs(body);
        // Requisition List 조회 모드 · Complete 완료 후: 본문 잠금 (Select Requisition만 항상 활성)
        applyReqWorkScrollLock(body);
        syncReqWorkMetaDatePickers(body);
        bindReqWorkListKeyboard();
        bindReqWorkHistListClicks();
        if (preservedHist) {
            attachReqWorkHistPanelToAnchor(preservedHist);
            setReqWorkHistOpen(true);
            syncReqListRowSelection(preservedHist);
            await syncReqHistPopoverToolbar();
            const hs = document.getElementById('reqWorkHistListScroll');
            if (hs) hs.scrollTop = histScrollTop;
            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                positionReqWorkHistPopover();
                syncReqWorkHistHeadPad();
            });
        } else if (_reqWorkHistOpen) {
            setReqWorkHistOpen(true);
            await refreshReqWorkHistList();
        }
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            syncReqWorkHeadLayout();
            requestAnimationFrame(syncReqWorkHeadLayout);
        });
        syncReqWorkMetaDatePickers(body);
        syncReqWorkListWindowHeadButtons();
    }

    async function ensureSpareTabForRequisition() {
        const st = getState();
        if (window.TVC_App?.switchTab && st.currentTab !== 'spare' && !stayOnSpareHistoryTab(st)) {
            TVC_App.switchTab('spare');
        }
    }

    async function startReqWorkSession(createNew = true, opts = {}) {
        const { st } = await vesselScope();
        if (!canCreateRequisition(st)) {
            await TVC_Dialog.alert('You do not have permission to create requisitions.');
            return;
        }
        closeReqSheetModal();
        closeReqListModal();
        if (createNew) {
            _reqWorkDraft = null;
            _reqSheet.reqId = null;
            st.requisitionDraft = [];
        }
        const m = modState(st);
        m.reqWorkListMode = true;
        m.reqWorkEditMode = false;
        m.reqWorkListEditing = false;
        m.reqWorkPostSaveView = false;
        m.reqWorkFromHistory = false;
        m.reqWorkPreview = false;
        m.reqWorkListDocPreview = false;
        m.reqWorkSmQuoteView = false;
        m.reqWorkSmEvalView = false;
        closeReqQuoteHeadPicks();
        m.reqWorkShowSelectedOnly = !!opts.listMode;
        m.reqWorkCompleted = false;
        m.reqWorkLastSavedId = null;
        await ensureReqWorkDraft(createNew);
        if (opts.listMode && _reqWorkDraft) clearReqListWindowAuditMeta(_reqWorkDraft);
        m.selectedReqId = _reqSheet.reqId;
        m.reqWorkOpen = true;
        m.reqWorkFocusedId = null;
        m.showReqPanel = false;
        m.panelOpen = false;
        if (opts.openSelectList) setReqWorkHistOpen(true, { reset: true });
        else setReqWorkHistOpen(false);
        await renderReqWorkModal();
        showSpicsModal('spareReqWorkModal');
    }

    async function startReqWorkEditSession(reqId) {
        const { st } = await vesselScope();
        if (!canCreateRequisition(st)) {
            await TVC_Dialog.alert('You do not have permission to create requisitions.');
            return;
        }
        closeReqSheetModal();
        await openRequisitionInListWindow(reqId, { editing: true });
    }

    async function startReqWorkPreviewSession(reqId) {
        closeReqSheetModal();
        await openRequisitionInListWindow(reqId, { editing: false });
    }

    async function reqWorkCancelDraft() {
        if (!await TVC_Dialog.confirm({ message: 'Cancel this requisition?' })) return;
        await closeReqWorkModal();
    }

    async function closeReqWorkModal() {
        const st = getState();
        const req = _reqWorkDraft;
        if (req?.id) {
            const confirmed = await tryApplySpareApprovalOnClose('requisition', req, req.department || st.department);
            if (confirmed) await refreshReqListUi();
        }
        const m = modState(st);
        m.reqWorkOpen = false;
        m.reqWorkFocusedId = null;
        m.reqWorkListMode = false;
        m.reqWorkEditMode = false;
        m.reqWorkListEditing = false;
        m.reqWorkPostSaveView = false;
        m.reqWorkFromHistory = false;
        m.reqWorkPreview = false;
        m.reqWorkListDocPreview = false;
        m.reqWorkShowSelectedOnly = false;
        m.reqWorkTreeOpen = false;
        m.modalSpareGroupKey = null;
        m.reqWorkCompleted = false;
        m.reqWorkLastSavedId = null;
        m.reqWorkSmQuoteView = false;
        m.reqWorkSmEvalView = false;
        closeReqQuoteHeadPicks();
        st.requisitionDraft = [];
        _reqWorkDraft = null;
        setReqWorkHistOpen(false);
        _reqListReturnAfterSave = false;
        if (_reqWorkResizeObs) { _reqWorkResizeObs.disconnect(); _reqWorkResizeObs = null; }
        if (vlReqWork) { vlReqWork.destroy(); vlReqWork = null; }
        document.getElementById('spareReqWorkModal')?.classList.remove('is-req-doc-preview');
        const wasHistOverlay = _spareHistReportOverlay;
        cleanupSpareHistReportOverlay();
        closeSpicsModal('spareReqWorkModal');
        if (wasHistOverlay) await refreshReqListUi();
        refreshSpareTabAfterModalClose();
    }

    async function reqWorkComplete() {
        const st = getState();
        const m = modState(st);
        if (m.reqWorkCompleted) return;
        if (!canCompleteRequisition(st)) {
            await TVC_Dialog.alert('Complete is available to Chief Engineer only.');
        }
        finalizeReqWorkDraftForSave();
        const req = getReqWorkSession();
        if (!req || !_reqWorkDraft) { await TVC_Dialog.alert('Requisition not found.'); return; }
        if (!_reqWorkDraft.req_no?.trim()) { await TVC_Dialog.alert('Enter Requisition No.'); return; }

        _reqWorkDraft.lines = (_reqWorkDraft.lines || []).filter(l => reqWorkSpareIdKey(l.spare_part_id));
        if (!_reqWorkDraft.lines.length) {
            await TVC_Dialog.alert('Select part(s).');
            return;
        }

        if (await reqWorkMissingRequestQtyAlert(_reqWorkDraft.lines)) return;

        // 작성/수정 완료 확인 — 취소 시 현재 화면 유지
        if (!await TVC_Dialog.confirm({ message: 'Complete this requisition?' })) return;

        // 확인 시 Made on = 오늘, by = 부서별 직책(Captain / Chief Engineer)
        applyReqWorkCompleteMeta(st, _reqWorkDraft);
        _reqWorkDraft.list_status = SPARE_LIST_STATUS.REPORTED;

        await TVC_Inventory.saveRequisition(_reqWorkDraft);
        const savedNo = _reqWorkDraft.req_no;
        const lineCount = _reqWorkDraft.lines.length;
        const savedId = _reqWorkDraft.id;
        _reqSheet.reqId = savedId;

        _reqListReturnAfterSave = false;
        m.reqWorkCompleted = true;
        m.reqWorkLastSavedId = savedId;
        st.requisitionDraft = [];
        await syncReportedWaitAndRefreshList();
        // 폼 데이터를 유지한 채 전체를 잠금 상태로 다시 렌더링 (입력 필드·버튼 disabled)
        await renderReqWorkModal();
        const doneMsg = m.reqWorkEditMode
            ? `Requisition ${savedNo} updated (${lineCount} line(s)).`
            : `Requisition ${savedNo} completed (${lineCount} line(s)) — added to Requisition List.`;
        await TVC_Dialog.alert(doneMsg);
    }

    async function reqWorkSwitchToNew() {
        const { st } = await vesselScope();
        if (!canCreateRequisition(st)) {
            await TVC_Dialog.alert('You do not have permission to create requisitions.');
            return;
        }
        const m = modState(st);
        if (m.reqWorkListEditing) return;
        if (!isRequisitionListWindow(m) || !m.reqWorkOpen) {
            await startReqWorkSession(true, { listMode: true, openSelectList: false });
        }
        await clearRequisitionListWindowSelection();
        m.reqWorkFromHistory = false;
        m.reqWorkPostSaveView = false;
        m.reqWorkListEditing = true;
        m.reqWorkShowSelectedOnly = false;
        modState(st).modalSpareGroupKey = null;
        st.treeSearch = '';
        clearReqWorkSearch(st);
        setReqWorkHistOpen(false);
        if (typeof TVC_ListFilters !== 'undefined') TVC_ListFilters.closePopover();
        await renderReqWorkModal();
    }

    async function reqWorkEnterListEdit() {
        const st = getState();
        const m = modState(st);
        if (!isRequisitionListWindow(m)) return;
        if (reqWorkVesselOrderedOrReceivedView()) {
            await TVC_Dialog.alert(reqWorkVesselPostOrderLockTip());
            return;
        }
        const displayedEarly = getReqWorkSession();
        if (!isReqListSmUser(st) && reqVesselReceivedExportComplete(displayedEarly)) {
            await TVC_Dialog.alert('Received data has been exported and cannot be changed.');
            return;
        }
        if (!canCreateRequisition(st)) {
            await TVC_Dialog.alert('You do not have permission to modify requisitions.');
            return;
        }
        if (!reqWorkListHasDisplayedReq(m)) {
            await TVC_Dialog.alert('Select a requisition from the list first.');
            return;
        }
        const displayed = getReqWorkSession();
        if (m.reqWorkFromHistory && !canModifyReqHistory(st, displayed)) {
            await TVC_Dialog.alert(reqHistModifyDisabledTitle(st, displayed) || 'Cannot modify this requisition.');
            return;
        }
        if (m.reqWorkListEditing) return;
        m.reqWorkListEditing = true;
        m.reqWorkPostSaveView = false;
        await renderReqWorkModal();
    }

    async function reqWorkCancelEdit() {
        const st = getState();
        const m = modState(st);
        if (!isRequisitionListWindow(m) || !m.reqWorkListEditing) return;
        closeReqQuoteHeadPicks();
        const reqId = _reqWorkDraft?.id || m.reqWorkLastSavedId || m.selectedReqId;
        m.reqWorkListEditing = false;
        m.reqWorkPostSaveView = false;
        if (m.reqWorkFromHistory && reqId) {
            await loadRequisitionIntoListWindow(reqId, { preserveHistPopover: false, keepFromHistory: true });
            m.reqWorkFromHistory = true;
            await renderReqWorkModal();
            return;
        }
        if (reqId) {
            await loadRequisitionIntoListWindow(reqId, { preserveHistPopover: true });
            return;
        }
        await clearRequisitionListWindowSelection();
    }

    async function applyReqWorkReceivedStock(user, req, prevReq) {
        const nextLines = (req.lines || [])
            .filter(l => reqWorkSpareIdKey(l.spare_part_id))
            .map(l => ({ spare_part_id: l.spare_part_id, qty: Number(l.qty_received) || 0 }));
        const prevLines = (prevReq?.lines || [])
            .filter(l => reqWorkSpareIdKey(l.spare_part_id))
            .map(l => ({ spare_part_id: l.spare_part_id, qty: Number(l.qty_received) || 0 }));
        const hasAnyReceived = nextLines.some(l => l.qty > 0);
        if (!hasAnyReceived && !prevReq?.stock_applied_at) return { applied: false };

        const noteParts = [
            req.received_on || req.received_date ? `Received: ${req.received_on || req.received_date}` : '',
            req.received_port ? `Port: ${req.received_port}` : '',
            req.ships_comments ? `Comments: ${req.ships_comments}` : '',
        ].filter(Boolean);
        const opts = {
            ref: req.req_no || '',
            note: noteParts.join(' · ') || 'Requisition received',
            source_id: req.id,
            source_type: 'requisition',
        };

        if (prevReq?.stock_applied_at) {
            await TVC_InventoryService.applyDeliveryDiff(user, prevLines, nextLines, opts);
            return { applied: true, at: prevReq.stock_applied_at };
        }
        if (!hasAnyReceived) return { applied: false };
        const deliverLines = nextLines.filter(l => l.qty > 0);
        const res = await TVC_InventoryService.recordDelivery(user, deliverLines, opts);
        return { applied: true, at: res.at };
    }

    async function reqWorkSave() {
        const st = getState();
        const m = modState(st);
        if (m.reqWorkCompleted) return;
        if (!isReqListSmUser(st) && reqVesselReceivedExportComplete(_reqWorkDraft || getReqWorkSession())) {
            await TVC_Dialog.alert('Received data has been exported and cannot be changed.');
            return;
        }
        if (isRequisitionListWindow(m) && !m.reqWorkListEditing && !reqWorkVesselReceivedRcvdOnlyEdit()) return;
        finalizeReqWorkDraftForSave();
        if (!_reqWorkDraft) { await TVC_Dialog.alert('Requisition not found.'); return; }
        if (!_reqWorkDraft.req_no?.trim()) { await TVC_Dialog.alert('Enter Requisition No.'); return; }

        _reqWorkDraft.lines = (_reqWorkDraft.lines || []).filter(l => reqWorkSpareIdKey(l.spare_part_id));
        if (!_reqWorkDraft.lines.length) { await TVC_Dialog.alert('Select part(s).'); return; }

        const isNewReqSave = isRequisitionListWindow(m) && m.reqWorkListEditing && !reqWorkListHasDisplayedReq(m);
        if (isNewReqSave && !await TVC_Dialog.confirm({ message: 'Save changes?' })) return;
        if (reqWorkReqQtyValidationActive(m) && await reqWorkMissingRequestQtyAlert(_reqWorkDraft.lines)) return;

        const dept = _reqWorkDraft.department || st.department;
        let pendingConfirm = false;
        let stockAppliedAt = _reqWorkDraft.stock_applied_at || '';
        if (isRequisitionListWindow(m)) {
            const cfCb = document.getElementById('reqWorkConfirmedBy');
            pendingConfirm = !!(cfCb?.checked && !cfCb.disabled);
            applySpareApprovalFromUi(_reqWorkDraft, 'reqWork', dept);
            if (!isReqListSmUser(st) && m.reqWorkVesselFlowStage === 'received') {
                const vf = ensureReqWorkVesselFlowState(_reqWorkDraft);
                const hasReceived = (_reqWorkDraft.lines || []).some(l => Number(l.qty_received) > 0);
                const hasDate = !!String(_reqWorkDraft.received_on || _reqWorkDraft.received_date || '').trim();
                if (hasReceived && hasDate) {
                    const user = spareInventoryUser(st);
                    if (!user) { await TVC_Dialog.alert('Sign in required.'); return; }
                    const prevReq = _reqWorkDraft.id ? await TVC_Inventory.getRequisition(_reqWorkDraft.id) : null;
                    try {
                        const stockRes = await applyReqWorkReceivedStock(user, _reqWorkDraft, prevReq);
                        if (stockRes.applied) {
                            stockAppliedAt = stockRes.at || stockAppliedAt;
                            _reqWorkDraft.stock_applied_at = stockAppliedAt;
                        }
                        vf.receiveSaved = true;
                        vf.flowStage = 'received';
                        reqVesselBumpMaxFlowStage(_reqWorkDraft, 'received');
                    } catch (e) {
                        await TVC_Dialog.alert(e.message || e.code || 'Inventory update failed');
                        return;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (stockAppliedAt) _reqWorkDraft.stock_applied_at = stockAppliedAt;

        await TVC_Inventory.saveRequisition(_reqWorkDraft);
        m.reqWorkLastSavedId = _reqWorkDraft.id;
        _reqSheet.reqId = _reqWorkDraft.id;
        if (stockAppliedAt) await reloadSparesCache({ vesselId: _reqWorkDraft.vessel_id || st.vessel_id });
        await syncReportedWaitAndRefreshList();

        if (isRequisitionListWindow(m)) {
            await enterReqPostSaveView(_reqWorkDraft.id);
            if (pendingConfirm && spareListStatus(_reqWorkDraft) === SPARE_LIST_STATUS.CONFIRMED) {
                await TVC_Dialog.alert('Confirmed.');
            } else {
                await TVC_Dialog.alert(`Requisition ${_reqWorkDraft.req_no} saved (${_reqWorkDraft.lines.length} line(s)).`);
            }
            return;
        }
    }

    async function openReqWorkPreviewWindow(ctx, print = false) {
        const pages = buildReqPreviewPagesHtml(ctx.st, ctx.req, ctx.vesselName);

        w.document.write(`<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><title>Parts Requisition — ${esc(ctx.req.req_no || '')}</title>
            <style>${reqPreviewPrintStyles()}</style></head><body>${pages}</body></html>`);
        w.document.close();
        w.focus();
        if (print) w.print();
    }

    async function reqWorkExportExcel() {
        const ctx = await reqWorkPrintContext();
        if (!ctx) {
            await TVC_Dialog.alert('Select a requisition from the list first.');
            return;
        }
        const m = modState(ctx.st);
        const isHq = !!(window.TVC_RBAC?.isSmAccount?.(ctx.st.user));
        const activeStage = reqWorkSmActiveFlowStage(m, ctx.req);
        const hqFormStages = ['requisition', 'evaluation', 'reply-evaluation', 'ordered', 'received'];
        if (isHq && isRequisitionListWindow(m) && hqFormStages.includes(activeStage)) {
            try {
                await exportReqPreviewExcel(ctx.st, ctx.req, ctx.vesselName, {
                    flowStage: activeStage,
                    vendorInfo: reqWorkExportVendorInfo(ctx.req),
                });
                return;
            } catch (e) {
                await TVC_Dialog.alert(`Excel export failed: ${e.message || e}`);
                return;
            }
        }
        const hqQuoteStages = ['request-quote', 'export-quote', 'import-quote', 'purchase-order'];
        if (isHq && isRequisitionListWindow(m) && hqQuoteStages.includes(activeStage)) {
            try {
                await exportReqQuoteExcel(ctx.st, ctx.req, ctx.vesselName, {
                    quoteMode: activeStage === 'purchase-order' ? 'order' : 'vendor',
                });
                return;
            } catch (e) {
                await TVC_Dialog.alert(`Excel export failed: ${e.message || e}`);
                return;
            }
        }
        await exportReqPreviewExcel(ctx.st, ctx.req, ctx.vesselName);
    }

    async function reqWorkPrintPreview() {

            const vesselName = await vesselLabel(vesselId);
            openReqWorkPreviewWindow({ st, req, vesselName }, true);
            return;
        }
        openReqWorkPreviewWindow(ctx, true);
    }

    function reqWorkRowQtyFocusEnabled() {
        return reqWorkEditable() || reqWorkSmEvalEditActive() || reqWorkVesselReceivedRcvdOnlyEdit();
    }

    function reqWorkEditable() {
        const m = modState(getState());
        return !!(m.reqWorkOpen && !m.reqWorkPreview && !reqWorkFormLocked());
    }

    function reqWorkNavigableSpares(st) {
        if (reqWorkVesselReceivedRcvdOnlyEdit()) {
            if (reqWorkUsesGroupedList(st)) {
                return reqWorkGroupedSections(st).flatMap(g => g.spares);
            }
            return _reqWorkCachedList || [];
        }
        if (reqWorkUsesGroupedList(st)) {
            return reqWorkGroupedSections(st).flatMap(g => g.spares.filter(s => reqWorkRowChecked(s)));
        }
        return (_reqWorkCachedList || []).filter(s => reqWorkRowChecked(s));
    }

    function findReqWorkRowTable(spareId) {
        const sid = reqWorkSpareIdKey(spareId);
        const scroll = document.getElementById('reqWorkListScroll');
        if (!scroll || !sid) return null;
        for (const el of scroll.querySelectorAll('[data-spare-id]')) {
            if (el.dataset.spareId === sid) return el;
        }
        return null;
    }

    function updateReqWorkRowFocusHighlight(prevId, nextId) {
        const scroll = document.getElementById('reqWorkListScroll');
        if (!scroll) return false;
        const clearSel = (id) => {
            if (!id) return;
            const table = findReqWorkRowTable(id);
            table?.querySelectorAll('.spare-row').forEach(tr => {
                tr.classList.remove('spare-row-focused', 'row-selected');
            });
        };
        const setSel = (id) => {
            if (!id) return;
            const table = findReqWorkRowTable(id);
            table?.querySelectorAll('.spare-row').forEach(tr => {
                tr.classList.add('spare-row-focused', 'row-selected');
            });
        };
        clearSel(prevId);
        setSel(nextId);
        return !!findReqWorkRowTable(nextId) || !nextId;
    }

    function syncReqWorkSingleGroupHeader(st) {
        if (reqWorkUsesGroupedList(st)) return;
        const block = document.getElementById('reqWorkEditBlock');
        if (!block) return;
        const m = modState(st);
        if (m.inlineEditId && m.inlineDraft?.header) {
            block.innerHTML = renderSpareEditBlockHtml(st);
        } else {
            block.innerHTML = renderSpareGroupHeaderHtml(st, { focusedId: m.reqWorkFocusedId });
        }
    }

    function scrollReqWorkRowIntoView(spareId) {
        const st = getState();
        const scroll = document.getElementById('reqWorkListScroll');
        if (!scroll || !spareId) return;
        if (vlReqWork && scroll.querySelector('.vl-inner')) {
            const idx = (_reqWorkCachedList || []).findIndex(s => reqWorkSameSpareId(s.id, spareId));
            if (idx < 0) return;
            const rowH = TVC_VirtualList.ROW_H || 36;
            const viewH = scroll.clientHeight || 400;
            const rowTop = idx * rowH;
            const rowBottom = rowTop + rowH;
            if (rowTop < scroll.scrollTop) scroll.scrollTop = rowTop;
            else if (rowBottom > scroll.scrollTop + viewH) scroll.scrollTop = rowBottom - viewH;
            return;
        }
        findReqWorkRowTable(spareId)?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
    }

    function focusReqWorkRequestInput(spareId) {
        if (!spareId || reqWorkFormLocked()) return false;
        const table = findReqWorkRowTable(spareId);
        const input = table?.querySelector('.spare-req-qty-input:not(.spare-req-eval-qty-input):not(.spare-req-rcvd-qty-input):not([disabled])');
        if (!input) return false;
        input.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        input.select();
        return true;
    }

    function focusReqWorkEvalInput(spareId) {
        if (!spareId || !reqWorkSmEvalEditActive()) return false;
        const table = findReqWorkRowTable(spareId);
        const input = table?.querySelector('.spare-req-eval-qty-input:not([disabled])');
        if (!input) return false;
        input.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        input.select();
        return true;
    }

    function focusReqWorkReceivedInput(spareId) {
        if (!spareId || !reqWorkReceivedQtyEditable()) return false;
        const table = findReqWorkRowTable(spareId);
        const input = table?.querySelector('.spare-req-rcvd-qty-input:not([disabled])');
        if (!input) return false;
        input.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        input.select();
        return true;
    }

    function focusReqWorkQtyInputOnce(spareId) {
        if (reqWorkVesselReceivedRcvdOnlyEdit()) return focusReqWorkReceivedInput(spareId);
        if (reqWorkSmEvalEditActive()) return focusReqWorkEvalInput(spareId);
        return focusReqWorkRequestInput(spareId);
    }

    function reqWorkUnlockRcvdInputsInScroll() {
        if (!reqWorkVesselReceivedRcvdOnlyEdit()) return;
        document.querySelectorAll('#reqWorkListScroll .spare-req-rcvd-qty-input').forEach(el => {
            el.removeAttribute('disabled');
        });
    }

    function deferFocusReqWorkQtyInput(spareId) {
        if (!spareId) return;
        let attempts = 0;
        const tick = () => {
            reqWorkUnlockRcvdInputsInScroll();
            if (focusReqWorkQtyInputOnce(spareId)) return;
            if (++attempts < 12) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
        };
        requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    }

    function focusReqWorkQtyInput(spareId) {
        deferFocusReqWorkQtyInput(spareId);
    }

    function reqWorkApplyRowFocus(spareId, focusQty = false, opts = {}) {
        const st = getState();
        const prevId = getFocusedSpareId(st);
        setFocusedSpareId(st, spareId || null);
        if (!opts.light) syncReqWorkSingleGroupHeader(st);
        scrollReqWorkRowIntoView(spareId);
        const scroll = document.getElementById('reqWorkListScroll');
        const vesselRcvdNav = reqWorkVesselReceivedRcvdOnlyEdit() && focusQty;
        if (reqWorkUsesGroupedList(st)) {
            const highlighted = updateReqWorkRowFocusHighlight(prevId, spareId);
            if (!highlighted) {
                if (patchReqWorkGroupedList()) { /* patched */ }
                else mountReqWorkGroupedList();
            }
        } else if (vlReqWork && scroll?.querySelector('.vl-inner')) {
            vlReqWork.refresh();
        } else {
            refreshReqWorkListRows();
        }
        syncSpareItemHistoryBtns();
        if (focusQty && spareId && reqWorkRowQtyFocusEnabled()) {
            const spare = (st.spares || []).find(s => reqWorkSameSpareId(s.id, spareId));
            if (spare && (vesselRcvdNav || reqWorkRowChecked(spare))) {
                deferFocusReqWorkQtyInput(spareId);
            }
        }
    }

    function reqWorkMoveFocusRow(delta) {
        if (!reqWorkRowQtyFocusEnabled()) return;
        const st = getState();
        const list = reqWorkNavigableSpares(st);
        if (!list.length) return;
        const curId = getFocusedSpareId(st);
        let idx = list.findIndex(s => reqWorkSameSpareId(s.id, curId));
        if (idx < 0) idx = delta > 0 ? -1 : list.length;
        const next = list[idx + delta];
        if (!next) return;
        reqWorkApplyRowFocus(next.id, true, { light: reqWorkVesselReceivedRcvdOnlyEdit() });
    }

    function onReqWorkListKeydown(e) {
        if (e.key !== 'ArrowUp' && e.key !== 'ArrowDown') return;
        if (!reqWorkRowQtyFocusEnabled()) return;
        const t = e.target;
        if (!t.closest?.('#reqWorkListScroll')) return;
        if (t.tagName === 'INPUT') {
            const evalMode = reqWorkSmEvalEditActive();
            const isEvalQty = t.classList.contains('spare-req-eval-qty-input');
            const isRcvdQty = t.classList.contains('spare-req-rcvd-qty-input');
            const isReqQty = t.classList.contains('spare-req-qty-input') && !isEvalQty && !isRcvdQty;
            if (reqWorkVesselReceivedRcvdOnlyEdit()) {
                if (!isRcvdQty) return;
                const table = t.closest('[data-spare-id]');
                const sid = table?.dataset?.spareId;
                if (sid) reqWorkSetReceivedQty(sid, t.value, { syncOnly: true });
            } else if (evalMode ? !isEvalQty : !isReqQty) return;
        }
        if (t.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' || t.tagName === 'SELECT') return;
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        reqWorkMoveFocusRow(e.key === 'ArrowDown' ? 1 : -1);
    }

    function bindReqWorkListKeyboard() {
        const modal = document.getElementById('spareReqWorkModal');
        if (!modal || modal._reqWorkKeyBound) return;
        modal._reqWorkKeyBound = true;
        modal.addEventListener('keydown', onReqWorkListKeydown, true);
    }

    function reqWorkFocusRow(spareId, focusQty = false) {
        if (spareId) reqWorkApplyRowFocus(spareId, focusQty);
        else {
            setFocusedSpareId(getState(), null);
            refreshReqWorkListRows();
        }
    }

    function reqWorkSyncRowCheckboxDom(spareId, checked) {
        const chk = findReqWorkRowTable(spareId)?.querySelector('.spare-row-chk');
        if (chk && !chk.disabled) chk.checked = !!checked;
    }

    /** Req. 클릭/포커스 시 좌측 체크박스 자동 선택 (라인 생성, DOM만 갱신) */
    function reqWorkEnsureRowChecked(spareId) {
        if (reqWorkVesselOrderedOrReceivedView()) return false;
        if (reqWorkFormLocked() && !reqWorkSmQuoteViewActive()) return false;
        const req = getReqWorkSession();
        if (!req) return false;
        const sid = reqWorkSpareIdKey(spareId);
        const spare = (getState().spares || []).find(s => reqWorkSameSpareId(s.id, sid));
        if (!spare) return false;
        if (reqWorkRowChecked(spare)) {
            reqWorkSyncRowCheckboxDom(spareId, true);
            return false;
        }
        captureReqWorkMeta();
        req.lines = req.lines || [];
        if (!req.lines.some(l => reqWorkSameSpareId(l.spare_part_id, sid))) {
            req.lines.push(buildReqLine(spare, 0));
        }
        syncRequisitionDraftFromLines();
        syncReqLineMap();
        syncReqWorkSaveBtn();
        touchReqWorkHqDraft();
        reqWorkSyncRowCheckboxDom(spareId, true);
        return true;
    }

    function reqWorkToggleRow(spareId, checked) {
        if (reqWorkVesselOrderedOrReceivedView()) return;
        if (reqWorkFormLocked()) return;
        const req = getReqWorkSession();
        if (!req) return;
        const sid = reqWorkSpareIdKey(spareId);
        captureReqWorkMeta();
        req.lines = req.lines || [];
        const spare = (getState().spares || []).find(s => reqWorkSameSpareId(s.id, sid));
        if (checked) {
            let line = req.lines.find(l => reqWorkSameSpareId(l.spare_part_id, sid));
            if (!line && spare) {
                line = buildReqLine(spare, 0);
                req.lines.push(line);
            }
        } else {
            req.lines = req.lines.filter(l => !reqWorkSameSpareId(l.spare_part_id, sid));
        }
        syncRequisitionDraftFromLines();
        syncReqLineMap();
        if (modState(getState()).reqWorkShowSelectedOnly && !reqWorkCheckedSpareCount(getState())) {
            modState(getState()).reqWorkShowSelectedOnly = false;
            refreshReqWorkListUi();
        } else if (checked && spare) {
            reqWorkApplyRowFocus(spareId, false);
        } else {
            refreshReqWorkListUiSoft();
        }
    }

    function reqWorkSetRequestQty(spareId, rawQty, opts = {}) {
        if (reqWorkVesselOrderedOrReceivedView()) return;
        if (reqWorkSmEvalStageActive()) return;
        if (reqWorkFormLocked() && !reqWorkSmQuoteViewActive()) return;
        const req = getReqWorkSession();
        if (!req) return;
        const sid = reqWorkSpareIdKey(spareId);
        captureReqWorkMeta();
        const qty = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(rawQty) || 0));
        req.lines = req.lines || [];
        let line = req.lines.find(l => reqWorkSameSpareId(l.spare_part_id, sid));
        const spare = (getState().spares || []).find(s => reqWorkSameSpareId(s.id, sid));
        if (!line && spare) {
            line = buildReqLine(spare, qty);
            req.lines.push(line);
        } else if (line) {
            line.qty_requested = qty;
        }
        syncRequisitionDraftFromLines();
        syncReqLineMap();
        syncReqWorkSaveBtn();
        touchReqWorkHqDraft();
        if (spare) reqWorkSyncRowCheckboxDom(spareId, reqWorkRowChecked(spare));
        if (opts.syncOnly) return;
        if (modState(getState()).reqWorkShowSelectedOnly && !reqWorkCheckedSpareCount(getState())) {
            modState(getState()).reqWorkShowSelectedOnly = false;
            refreshReqWorkListUi();
        } else {
            refreshReqWorkListUiSoft();
        }
        if (reqWorkSmQuoteViewActive()) syncReqWorkQuoteTotalsDom();
    }

    function reqWorkEvalQtyKeydown(e, spareId) {
        if (e.key !== 'ArrowUp' && e.key !== 'ArrowDown') return;
        if (!reqWorkSmEvalEditActive()) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        reqWorkMoveFocusRow(e.key === 'ArrowDown' ? 1 : -1);
    }

    function reqWorkSetEvalQty(spareId, rawQty, opts = {}) {
        if (!reqWorkSmEvalEditActive()) return;
        const req = getReqWorkSession();
        if (!req) return;
        const sid = reqWorkSpareIdKey(spareId);
        const qty = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(rawQty) || 0));
        const line = (req.lines || []).find(l => reqWorkSameSpareId(l.spare_part_id, sid));
        if (!line) return;
        line.qty_approved = qty;
        syncReqLineMap();
        if (reqWorkSmQuoteViewActive()) syncReqWorkQuoteTotalsDom();
        syncReqWorkHqFlowBtns();
        if (opts.syncOnly) return;
        touchReqWorkHqDraft();
    }

    function reqWorkSetReceivedQty(spareId, rawQty, opts = {}) {
        if (!reqWorkReceivedQtyEditable()) return;
        if (reqWorkFormLocked() && !reqWorkVesselReceivedRcvdOnlyEdit()) return;
        const req = getReqWorkSession();
        if (!req) return;
        const sid = reqWorkSpareIdKey(spareId);
        const qty = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(rawQty) || 0));
        const line = (req.lines || []).find(l => reqWorkSameSpareId(l.spare_part_id, sid));
        if (!line) return;
        line.qty_received = qty;
        syncReqLineMap();
        if (opts.syncOnly) return;
        syncReportedWaitMap().then(() => {
            refreshReqWorkListUiSoft();
            refreshReqListUi();
        });
    }

    async function reqWorkAddSpare(spareId, silent = false) {
        const req = getReqWorkSession()
            || (_reqSheet.reqId ? await TVC_Inventory.getRequisition(_reqSheet.reqId) : null);
        if (!req) return false;
        const sid = reqWorkSpareIdKey(spareId);
        if ((req.lines || []).some(l => reqWorkSameSpareId(l.spare_part_id, sid))) {
            if (!silent) await TVC_Dialog.alert('Part already added.');
            return false;
        }
        const spare = (getState().spares || []).find(s => reqWorkSameSpareId(s.id, sid));
        if (!spare) return false;
        req.lines = req.lines || [];
        req.lines.push(buildReqLine(spare, 0));
        syncRequisitionDraftFromLines();
        if (!_reqWorkDraft) await TVC_Inventory.saveRequisition(req);
        await syncReqLineMap();
        if (!silent) {
            captureReqWorkMeta();
            refreshReqWorkListUi();
        }
        return true;
    }

    /** SPARE 목록에서 선택한 부품을 New Requisition draft로 복사 (체크 상태는 목록·청구서 각각 독립) */
    async function addToRequisition() {
        const st = getState();
        if (!canCreateRequisition(st)) {
            await TVC_Dialog.alert('You do not have permission to create requisitions.');
        }
        const ids = spareListSelectedIds(st);
        if (!ids.length) await TVC_Dialog.alert('Select parts using the checkbox.');

        const m = modState(st);
        const writableOpen = isRequisitionListWindow(m) && m.reqWorkOpen && m.reqWorkListEditing
            && !m.reqWorkPreview && !m.reqWorkCompleted;
        if (!writableOpen) {
            await reqWorkSwitchToNew();
        }

        let added = 0;
        for (const id of ids) {
            if (await reqWorkAddSpare(id, true)) added++;
        }
        syncRequisitionDraftFromLines();
        clearSpareListSelection(st);
        captureReqWorkMeta();
        refreshList();
        refreshReqWorkListUi();
        if (added) await TVC_Dialog.alert(`${added} part(s) added to requisition.`);
        else await TVC_Dialog.alert('Selected parts are already on the requisition or cannot be added.');
    }

    async function reqWorkAddChecked() {
        await addToRequisition();
    }

    function spareListExportContext() {
        const st = getState();
        const list = _cachedList.length ? _cachedList : filteredSpares(st);
        const ship = document.getElementById('cmaxsShipName')?.textContent?.trim() || '—';
        const dept = window.TVC_RBAC ? TVC_RBAC.getDeptLabel(st.department) : 'All';
        const filterParts = [];
        const q = spareListSearchQuery(st);
        if (q) filterParts.push(`Search: "${q}"`);
        const sf = spareActiveFilterLabel(modState(st));
        if (sf) filterParts.push(`Filter: ${sf}`);
        const gLabel = groupFilterLabel(st);
        if (gLabel) filterParts.push(`Group: ${gLabel}`);
        const rows = list.map(s => {
            const pipe = sparePipelineCols(s);
            return {
                code: spareNumbering(s),
                class: spareClass(s) === '—' ? '' : spareClass(s),
                dwgNo: spareDwgNo(s, st),
                item: s.name || '',
                partNo: spareDrawingNo(s) || '',
                unit: spareUnit(s),
                working: String(spareWorking(s) || ''),
                standard: String(spareStandardQty(s)),
                stock: String(pipe.stock),
                awaiting: String(pipe.awaiting),
                need: pipe.need == null ? '—' : String(pipe.need),
            };
        });
        return { ship, dept, filterParts, rows, count: list.length, exportedAt: new Date() };
    }

    function buildPrintBody() {
        const ctx = spareListExportContext();
        const filterNote = ctx.filterParts.length
            ? `<p class="meta">${ctx.filterParts.map(p => esc(p)).join(' · ')}</p>` : '';
        const rows = ctx.rows.map(r => `<tr>
            <td>${esc(r.code)}</td>
            <td>${esc(r.class)}</td>
            <td>${esc(r.dwgNo || '—')}</td>
            <td>${esc(r.partNo || '—')}</td>
            <td>${esc(r.item)}</td>
            <td>${esc(r.unit)}</td>
            <td>${esc(r.working)}</td>
            <td>${esc(r.standard)}</td>
            <td>${esc(r.stock)}</td>
            <td>${esc(r.awaiting)}</td>
            <td>${esc(r.need)}</td>
        </tr>`).join('');
        return `<h1>SPARE Parts List</h1>
            <p class="meta">${esc(ctx.ship)} · ${esc(ctx.dept)} · ${ctx.exportedAt.toLocaleString()}</p>
            ${filterNote}
            <p class="meta">${ctx.count} part${ctx.count === 1 ? '' : 's'}</p>
            <table><tr>
                <th>Code</th><th>Class</th><th>Dwg No.</th><th>Part No.</th><th>Items</th>
                <th>Unit</th><th title="${SPARE_COL_WORK_TITLE}">${SPARE_COL_WORK}</th><th title="${SPARE_COL_STD_TITLE}">${SPARE_COL_STD}</th><th title="${SPARE_COL_ROB_TITLE}">${SPARE_COL_ROB}</th><th title="${SPARE_COL_WAIT_TITLE}">${SPARE_COL_WAIT}</th><th title="${SPARE_COL_NEED_TITLE}">${SPARE_COL_NEED}</th>
            </tr>${rows || '<tr><td colspan="11">No parts to print.</td></tr>'}</table>`;
    }

    async function exportPartsListXlsx() {
        const ctx = spareListExportContext();
        if (!ctx.rows.length) await TVC_Dialog.alert('No parts to export.');
        if (typeof TVC_Excel === 'undefined' || !TVC_Excel.exportSparePartsList) {
            await TVC_Dialog.alert('Excel export is not available.');
        }
        try {
            await TVC_Excel.exportSparePartsList(ctx);
        } catch (e) {
            await TVC_Dialog.alert(e.message || 'Export failed');
        }
    }

    async function exportPartsList() {
        const spares = (getState().spares || []).map(canon);
        if (!spares.length) await TVC_Dialog.alert('No parts to export.');
        const headers = ['Code', 'Class', 'Dwg No.', 'Part No.', 'Items', 'Unit', SPARE_COL_WORK, SPARE_COL_STD, SPARE_COL_ROB, 'Group'];
        const rows = spares.map(s => [
            spareNumbering(s),
            spareClass(s) === '—' ? '' : spareClass(s),
            spareDwgNo(s, getState()),
            partNo(s),
            s.name || '',
            s.unit || '',
            s.workingStock ?? s.working_stock ?? '',
            s.standardStock ?? s.standard_stock ?? '',
            TVC_Inventory.currentStock(s),
            s.group || '',
        ]);
        const csv = [headers, ...rows]
            .map(r => r.map(c => `"${String(c ?? '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`).join(','))
            .join('\r\n');
        const blob = new Blob(['\ufeff' + csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8' });
        await TVC_FileExport.save(blob, `spare-parts-list-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`);
    }

    // ── Consumption Report (New Requisition 스타일 모달) ───────────────
    const CONSUME_PICK_Z = 10060;

    const CONSUME_NO_GROUP_LABEL = 'No PMS GROUP';

    function newConsumeJobRow(overrides = {}) {
        return {
            job_code: overrides.job_code || '',
            sort1: overrides.sort1 || '',
            sort2: overrides.sort2 || '',
            job_detail: overrides.job_detail || '',
        };
    }

    function ensureConsumeJobItems(draft) {
        if (!draft) return [];
        if (!Array.isArray(draft.job_items) || !draft.job_items.length) {
            draft.job_items = [newConsumeJobRow({
                job_code: draft.job_code || '',
                sort1: draft.sort1 || '',
                sort2: draft.sort2 || '',
                job_detail: draft.job_detail || '',
            })];
        }
        return draft.job_items;
    }

    function syncConsumeDraftJobSummary(draft) {
        ensureConsumeJobItems(draft);
        const items = draft.job_items;
        const codes = items.map(i => String(i.job_code || '').trim()).filter(Boolean);
        draft.job_code = codes.length > 1 ? codes.join(', ') : (codes[0] || '');
        const first = items[0] || newConsumeJobRow();
        draft.sort1 = first.sort1 || '';
        draft.sort2 = first.sort2 || '';
        draft.job_detail = first.job_detail || '';
    }

    function consumeLogJobItems(log) {
        if (!log) return [];
        if (Array.isArray(log.job_items) && log.job_items.length) {
            return log.job_items.map(i => newConsumeJobRow(i));
        }
        if (log.job_code || log.sort1 || log.sort2 || log.job_detail) {
            return [newConsumeJobRow({
                job_code: log.job_code || '',
                sort1: log.sort1 || '',
                sort2: log.sort2 || '',
                job_detail: log.job_detail || '',
            })];
        }
        return [newConsumeJobRow()];
    }

    function consumeJobBatchEnabled(draft, ro) {
        if (ro) return false;
        return !(draft?.work_report_id || draft?.source === 'work_report');
    }

    function newConsumeDraft(st, user) {
        const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
        return {
            source: 'consume',
            consumed_date: today,
            made_on: today,
            made_by: spareReportedByForUser(user),
            created_by_username: user?.username || '',
            reporter_role: user ? (TVC_RBAC.resolveUserRole(user) || user.role || '') : '',
            file_no: '',
            voy_no: '',
            place: '',
            list_status: SPARE_LIST_STATUS.DRAFT,
            confirmed_by: '',
            confirmed_at: '',
            approved_by: '',
            approved_at: '',
            spare_group_key: '',
            spare_group_label: '',
            job_code: '',
            sort1: '',
            sort2: '',
            job_detail: '',
            job_items: [newConsumeJobRow()],
            ships_comments: '',
            lines: [],
        };
    }

    function isCriticalMaintenanceJob(j) {
        if (!j) return false;
        const sort = String(j.sort || '').trim().toUpperCase();
        if (sort.startsWith('C.') || sort.includes('CRITICAL')) return true;
        return String(j.item_sort1 || '').toUpperCase().includes('CRITICAL');
    }

    function consumeJobsForGroup(st, groupKey) {
        if (!st.idx && (st.jobs || []).length && window.TVC_Indexes) {
            st.idx = TVC_Indexes.build(st);
        }
        ensureSpareGroupNodes(st);
        if (!st.idx) return [];
        let jobs = (st.jobs || []).filter(j => !st.department || j.department === st.department);
        if (groupKey === CRITICAL_GROUP_KEY) {
            jobs = jobs.filter(isCriticalMaintenanceJob);
        } else if (groupKey === MERGED_GEN_ENGINE_KEY) {
            jobs = jobs.filter(j => mapsToMergedGeneratorSpare(j.group, j.department));
        } else if (groupKey) {
            const set = new Set(st.idx.jobsByGroupKey.get(groupKey) || []);
            jobs = jobs.filter(j => set.has(j.id));
        }
        return jobs.sort((a, b) => String(a.job_code || '').localeCompare(String(b.job_code || '')));
    }
